ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio between high-intensity white/light-grey distal lobe regions and low-intensity black/dark-grey central fluke region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-intensity block occupying the central fluke body and median notch area; distal lobes exhibit white-base intensity with high-frequency black focal spots and irregular mottling clustered toward the outer margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a deep central point; sides of the notch meet at an estimated interior angle of 40-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of 2-5 pixels along the distal portions of the trailing edge; right lobe exhibits more pronounced peak-and-valley topography than the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve with a shallow convex sweep transitioning to an upward curvature at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel nodes located at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several dark, short linear pixel disruptions visible on the inner-ventral surface of the right lobe, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral colonization by epibionts at the distal tips, resulting in a jagged, irregular terminal boundary.
